svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

metadata.orrery:spec: # yaml-language-server: $schema=../references/diagram.schema.json title: Blog data model subtitle: "The core of Ghost's schema: staff write posts, members comment, tags file posts" kind: er # The shape of the open-source Ghost CMS schema (posts, users, tags, posts_tags, members, # comments), trimmed to the columns that carry the relationships. Staff users and paying members # are separate tables there, so the two kinds of people never mix. nodes: users: note: Staff fields: - id uuid pk - email text unique - name text - slug text unique members: note: Readers # In the posts' column, beside the comments they write. rank: 2 fields: - id uuid pk - email text unique - name text null - status text posts: fields: - id uuid pk - author_id uuid fk - title text - slug text unique - status text - published_at timestamptz null tags: rank: 2 fields: - id uuid pk - name text - slug text unique comments: fields: - id uuid pk # Member first: its line comes in from above, the post's from below. - member_id uuid fk - post_id uuid fk - html text - created_at timestamptz # Many to many: a post carries many tags and a tag files many posts, one row per pair. posts_tags: fields: - post_id uuid pk fk - tag_id uuid pk fk - sort_order int edges: # author_id names no table, so the rows it joins are named. - users -- posts: { card: "1:0..n", label: writes, from_field: id, to_field: author_id } - posts -- comments: { card: "1:0..n", label: has } - members -- comments: { card: "1:0..n", label: writes } - posts -- posts_tags: { card: "1:0..n", label: filed as } - tags -- posts_tags: { card: "1:0..n", label: files }

svg.title: Blog data model
svg.desc: Blog data model. 6 components. Connections: users to posts (writes); posts to comments (has); members to comments (writes); posts to posts_tags (filed as); tags to posts_tags (files).

text.tspan: The core of Ghost's schema: staff write posts, members comment, tags file posts
